events.command: for f in build/cache/tmp.bin build/out.o junk.log notes.tmp; do echo "=== $f ==="; ls -l "$f"; file "$f"; head -c 300 "$f"; echo; done
rm build/cache/tmp.bin build/out.o junk.log notes.tmp && rmdir build/cache build && echo "removed"
